points.description: Setup and sampling: weights arranged in a lattice/topology and initialised randomly, then an input is sampled from the input space (in a loop).
points.partial_credit: Half if only initialisation or only sampling is given.

points.description: Core iteration: find the winning neuron by matching the input to the closest neuron, update the winner and its neighbours using a neighbourhood function, shrink neighbourhood/learning rate, and repeat until convergence.
points.partial_credit: Half if the winner is found and updated but neighbours, shrinking, or the repeat/stop step is missing.

rubric.notes: Full marks for a pseudo-code (or step list) in any wording that has initialise, sample input, find winning neuron, update winner and neighbours, and loop until done. Give part marks if the answer is on the right track but misses a major stage or is vague. Give no marks for an unrelated algorithm. Do not penalise missing details such as decaying the radius, or syntax.
